comparisons.peer_topic: All Other net loss decrease drivers
comparisons.peer_summary: The net loss in All Other decreased by $2.3 billion to $1.6 billion, primarily driven by lower noninterest expense and higher revenue.
comparisons.comparison: Both C and BAC report performance metrics for their 'All Other' or 'Corporate/Other' segments, which serve as catch-alls for non-core or legacy items. C attributes a 20% revenue decline in All Other to net investment securities losses and higher funding costs. In contrast, BAC reports a decrease in net loss for All Other, driven by lower noninterest expense and higher revenue. While both highlight 'All Other' segment volatility, C's decline is driven by investment losses and funding costs, whereas BAC saw an improvement driven by expense management and revenue growth.

sentences.text: All Other (managed basis) revenues decreased 20%, driven by lower revenues in Corporate/Other and Legacy Franchises.
The decline in Corporate/Other was largely driven by net investment securities losses due to the repositioning of the investment securities portfolio and higher funding costs.
The net loss in All Other decreased $2.3 billion to $1.6 billion primarily due to lower noninterest expense and higher revenue.
